title: The Creator Speaks
intro: September 26–October 2, 2026. Explore the gift of prophecy as God’s provision for restoring His image in humanity and the communion that sin disrupted.
heroQuote: The gift of prophecy is therefore an expression of God's determination to restore the relationship that sin destroyed.

footer.text: God, who at various times and in various ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets, has in these last days spoken to us by His Son.

themes.title: God Speaks to Restore Communion
themes.summary: The Creator continues speaking to fallen humanity through prophets and most fully through His Son. The gift of prophecy expresses His determination to restore the relationship broken by sin.

themes.title: From Image Lost to Image Restored
themes.summary: Humanity was created in God’s image. Sin damaged that likeness, but through Christ and the Spirit it is renewed until we are conformed to His image and become like Him.

themes.title: 1. Creation — Direct Communication With God
themes.summary: Adam and Eve were made for direct communion with God. He spoke to them personally; prophetic messengers were not part of their original need.

themes.title: 2. The Great Controversy Begins With Two Voices
themes.summary: God’s word and the serpent’s word contradict one another. The controversy concerns whose word can be trusted and whose representation of God’s character is true.

themes.title: 3. Sin Produces Hiding
themes.summary: After sin, God’s voice evokes fear and hiding. Humanity’s perception of Him changes, disrupting the openness of communion.

themes.title: 4. God Seeks Humanity — Where Are You?
themes.summary: God does not abandon Adam and Eve after the Fall. His question reveals His pursuit of the broken relationship: He speaks because He wants His children back.

themes.title: 5. The First Prophecy Is Also the First Gospel
themes.summary: The promise of the coming Seed points to Christ’s victory over the serpent. The lesson traces this Christ-centered purpose through Scripture and the testimony of Jesus.

themes.title: 6. Why Prophets Became Necessary
themes.summary: Sin separates humanity from God and alters its ability to experience His unveiled presence. The prophetic gift is an accommodation of divine grace during this separation.

themes.title: 7. Prophecy — Communication Through Human Messengers
themes.summary: God makes Himself known through visions and dreams and reveals His purposes to His servants the prophets. Prophecy maintains communication with fallen humanity.

themes.title: 8. Christ — God Comes Personally to Speak
themes.summary: God’s revelation advances from speaking through prophets to speaking through His Son. The Word becomes flesh, and Jesus reveals the Father most fully.

themes.title: 9. The Holy Spirit Continues the Communication
themes.summary: The Spirit guides believers into truth and bears witness that they are God’s children. Through Him, Christ continues making Himself known while His people await face-to-face fellowship.

themes.title: 10. The Consummation — Direct Communion Restored
themes.summary: Revelation brings the story back to Eden: God dwells with humanity, and His servants see His face. The relationship disrupted by sin is fully restored.

themes.title: Present Condition — We Prophesy in Part
themes.summary: Prophecy belongs to the present age of partial knowledge. It is God’s gracious provision until the restoration of face-to-face communion, when partial knowledge gives way to fullness.
